exec git init -b main
env TZ=UTC
at 2026-07-22T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix mail-

exec card --actor intake-router --json mail send case-owner 'case 184 needs classification'
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/sent.json
exec card --actor intake-router mail recv --peek
! stdout .
exec card --actor queue-observer mail recv --peek
! stdout .
exec card --actor case-owner --json mail recv --peek
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/delivered.jsonl
